summary: wormgpt-cli ships a full-featured C2 implant with postinstall persistence, credential theft, and reverse shell
details: Package declares a postinstall hook (`node -e "require('./src/postinstall.js')"`) that reads a baked `.implant.env` and spawns `src/implant/loader.js` as a detached, stdio-ignored, windowsHide child with `WORMGPT_DAEMON=1`, launching a persistent implant daemon on any `npm install`. `bin/victim.js` — mapped to the `wormgpt-cli`, `wormgpt`, `deepholegpt`, and `wgpt` commands — additionally calls `require('.../src/implant/loader.js').boot({silent:true})` before any CLI subcommand runs, providing a redundant activation path that survives `--ignore-scripts`. `src/protocol.js` hardcodes the C2 base `http://13.60.13.215:7771` with a rotating C2 pool and a DNS TXT dead-drop update channel (`WORMGPT_DNS_DEADROP`), wraps traffic in AES-256-GCM+HMAC envelopes, and dispatches opcodes including OP_SHELL, OP_PYEXEC, OP_PTY_START/STOP, OP_DOWNLOAD, OP_UPLOAD, OP_UPDATE, and OP_PERSIST — a full reverse-shell/PTY channel executing remote-operator commands on the installer host. `src/implant/loader.js` runs a watchdog that respawns the implant up to 50 times per session and persists state under `<tmpdir>/.sc_cache/`. `src/implant/stealers/clipboard.js` polls the clipboard every 2 seconds via `powershell Get-Clipboard`/`pbpaste`/`xclip` and matches content against regexes for RSA/EC/OpenSSH private keys, BIP-39 12–24 word mnemonics, Discord tokens, AWS AKIA keys, GitHub `gh[opusr]_` tokens, JWTs, credit card numbers, BTC/ETH addresses, and password/api-key fields, flushing hits to the C2. Additional modules implement keylogging (PowerShell `GetAsyncKeyState` with an AMSI bypass loaded via `-EncodedCommand`), screenshot capture, browser credential extraction, filesystem loot collection, LAN lateral scanning, privilege-escalation checks, and anti-forensics/evidence wiping — all beaconed through the encrypted envelope channel to `http://13.60.13.215:7771`.
